l3_l10_contract_scope.l10_failure_observation: oracle/意味/順序違反を保持し、該当上流へ戻す。

comparison_method: After fixed comment/hash verification, compare only source-only negative meanings against every existing L4 F03 classification and L9 F03 negative row. findings: All nine existing L4 F03 conditions are text-equal to their paired L9 F03 condition strings; each existing row has a corresponding existing L8 unit_case_ref.

Blind F03-03 is one source-only preservation condition spanning four distinct existing witness rows (public, architecture, state, requirement); this many-to-one relation does not create a row oracle or canonical class.
Blind F03-04 covers two distinct witnesses (minimal body scope expansion and incorrect Green observation); it does not establish their shared code/classification.

The CI-as-quality witness has matching direction, but its existing axis/state projection is not independently determined by the fixed source-only artifact; preserve it as unresolved in candidate rows.
Existing L4/L9 axis/state/backflow owner assignments match per row; this confirms existing pairing only and does not elevate them to the independent L3/L10 oracle.

unresolved.sequence_equality: The sources establish causal/order constraints (notably pre-body Red before body change, followed by Green/refactor/atomic CI), but do not specify a canonical sequence encoding, identity, or exact equality comparator. Derivation checks order/causality only; exact sequence equality remains undecided.
unresolved.failure_code: L4 failure_conditions contain local code labels, but L3/L10 prose does not establish a normative failure-code vocabulary, mapping, or precedence. No code is elevated to a canonical output code; code selection remains undecided.
unresolved.oracle_unit_vs_u_id_rows: The L3/L10 contracts are oracle-contract units (F03, F04, B01); a U-ID row would be a finer test/fixture instance. One contract can motivate multiple negative conditions, and one condition could need multiple row fixtures. No one-to-one mapping or U-ID identity is inferred here.
unresolved.architecture_algorithm_boundary: The /architecture pointer includes an ordered data_flow and detailed connections. These were not used to derive negative cases because the request excludes L4 algorithmic content; only non-algorithmic role/boundary prose was considered.
unresolved.fixture_authority: L4 input/output contract prose labels examples synthetic/minimal and says real operation/authority/codec need separate binding. No runtime result, authority state, or formal codec is inferred from these fixtures.
